name: email.inbox
description: Read your five latest inbox messages, newest first, including full bodies, sender and messageId for replies.

name: email.send
description: Send a message from your own mailbox and save it to Sent. For a threaded reply, set inReplyTo to the received messageId. A sent=true result means SMTP accepted it, even if saving the Sent copy failed.

inReplyTo.description: Optional Message-ID of the message being answered, copied from email.inbox.
